title: ASML Holding N.V. Form 20-F for fiscal year 2004

passages.locator: Item 4.B, printed pp. 14–15, Business Overview and Products
passages.note: ASML reports delivering three pre-production immersion tools during the second half of 2004: two to research institutes and one to a commercial customer. It does not assign model numbers in that count. It distinguishes them from anticipated volume shipments and explains the separate wet exposure and dry measurement stations.

passages.locator: Item 5, Critical Accounting Policies, Revenue Recognition
passages.note: ASML attributes the engineering change to immersion add-on modules for existing TWINSCAN models. One immersion system had passed factory acceptance and was under installation at year end when its revenue was recognized.
